name: Character Of The Wicked
overview: The character of the wicked, as revealed in Proverbs 1:10-14, is marked by enticing others to join in violent and deceitful schemes against the innocent, motivated by greed and a desire to enrich themselves at the expense of others. They conspire to harm without cause, showing a blatant disregard for righteousness and a willingness to unite in sinful pursuits. This passage exposes their corrupt nature, highlighting traits such as deceit, covetousness, and a destructive intent that stands in stark opposition to the faithful.
